WITH counts_by_rating AS (
  SELECT 
    f.rating,
    COUNT(*) AS rental_count
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(rental_count) AS avg_count
  FROM counts_by_rating
)
SELECT 
  AVG(cbr.rental_count) AS avg_count_for_above_average_ratings,
  AVG(cbr.rental_count - oa.avg_count) AS avg_excess_above_overall_average
FROM counts_by_rating cbr
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE cbr.rental_count > oa.avg_count
